repository_state.commit_message:
feat: add Gemini billing-report task_type to model router

Wires a dedicated Gemini API provider branch (not Ollama) into the
model router for billing-report generation, using a separate
GEMINI_BILLING_API_KEY so cost tracking stays isolated from the
shared GEMINI_API_KEY. Also fixes a KeyError in /api/model/status
when a task_type policy has no keep_alive (cloud providers don't
use one).
